qualitative_policy: Sort test records by patient then numeric slice then image path. Before inference choose the lower median by area in each nonempty small/medium/large group, and the first empty slice. After inference add, for each trained model at 0.5, the lowest-Dice positive slice and the empty slice with most FP pixels (only if FP exists); ties use sorted record order. Show every selected slice with GT and all four trained-model operating points on FLAIR channel 1. Failures are explicitly outcome-selected, not representative prevalence estimates.
